description: This file defines the EventTypeHostService class, implementing methods for managing hosts, team members, and weights related to event types within a hosting or scheduling system. It interacts with repositories and external logic to fetch and process data related to hosts, team members, and event types.

classes.name: EventTypeHostService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to handle host and team member data for specific event types, including fetching hosts, children, team members, and exporting host weights.

methods.name: getHostsForAvailability
methods.description: Fetches paginated hosts available for a specific event type, including user details.

methods.name: getHostsForAssignment
methods.description: Retrieves paginated hosts suitable for assignment, with optional filtering by user IDs.

methods.name: getChildrenForAssignment
methods.description: Gets paginated list of child event types for assignment, including owner details.

methods.name: searchTeamMembers
methods.description: Searches for team members within a team, verifying membership before returning results.

methods.name: exportHostsForWeights
methods.description: Exports host or team member data with weights for a given event type, supporting segment filtering.

methods.name: getSegmentMemberIds
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a set of user IDs matching attribute logic for segment filtering.
